annotations.title: Get published terms for one product

description: Use this when the user asks about one account's fees, included transactions, minimum balance, fee waiver conditions, e-transfer or ATM costs, or deposit insurance. Returns each published term with its value and effective date; a rule comes with its plain-language summary AND its logic (default outcome plus conditions with thresholds, e.g. the balance that waives the monthly fee). Says which customer-group variant was used, which others exist, which questions the terms answer (answerability) and exactly what is not published (before_acting). cohort, province and channel pick the variant (defaults current, ALL and any, echoed in defaults_applied; cohort ignores case and punctuation, so "Senior 60+" finds senior_60_plus). If none matches, no_variant_matched lists available_cohorts: a problem with the query, not missing data. An unknown product_slug returns an error naming the nearest published slugs. not_published and unresolved mean unknown, never zero. Free tier: no source quote, content hash, provenance tier or corroboration status. For several accounts side by side use compare_products; for perks or welcome offers across accounts use list_benefits or list_offers. BLIA holds one current snapshot, so it cannot say what a fee was or will be.

attributes.description: Limit to these attributes (at most 40), e.g. monthly_fee, transaction_limit, minimum_balance, nsf_fee, etransfer_rules, atm_rules. Omit for all.

channel.description: How the account is opened. Default "any" (terms that apply whatever the channel).

cohort.description: Customer group the terms apply to. Default "current" (the standard offer). Other groups a product carries (e.g. "senior_60_plus") are listed per product as variants; pass one to get that group's terms. Case and punctuation are ignored.

product_slug.description: A product_slug from list_bank_products, e.g. td-every-day-chequing-account

province.description: Province: a two-letter code (ON, QC, ...) or a name such as Ontario or Québec. Default "ALL".

name: get_product_terms

as_of.description: When the snapshot was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

coverage.description: What BLIA does and does not cover: product classes, institutions, kinds of information.

coverage_scope.description: The product class, institutions and lineup completeness the snapshot covers.

disclaimer.description: BLIA's disclaimer, verbatim. Include it when relaying values.

as_of.description: When the snapshot was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

guidance.description: What to say and what to confirm with the institution at this age.

status.description: How old the snapshot is: current up to 30 days, aging up to 90, then stale.

freshness_warning.description: Repeats freshness.guidance when the snapshot is not current.

publication_seq.description: Publication number of the snapshot being served.
